authorization: 2026-10-26 direct user: use EdgeTAM to replace SAM2; retain original interpolation plus a mature published propagation method, same eight expert boxes, observed frames keep input boxes, common current time branch, pilot correctness/cost before deciding full execution.

method.name: EdgeTAM
method.prompt: Exactly original eight normalized expert boxes converted to official pixel xyxy; no expert masks, no new expert. No new clipping, confidence selection or prompt replacement.
method.propagation: All8 box prompts for one object before tracking; official propagate_in_video(start_frame_idx=0,reverse=False). Coverage must be exactly every native frame once; no reverse pass or custom fusion. This is an offline all-conditioning comparison, not causal online tracking.
method.output: Masks>0 to normalized half-open bounding boxes; empty unobserved output remains zero-area, no Source fallback. Eight observed outputs overwritten with exact original input boxes.
method.time: Reuse current audited q1 MAP interval; only spatial trajectory varies. tIoU must be identical by construction; main SourceNative and matched-time Source are distinct.
method.interpolation: Reuse already audited original center/logsize interpolation and its outside-anchor convention; no silent switch to a new xyxy-linear rule.
method.metrics: vIoU/R03/R05 plus matched tIoU/sIoU and unobserved fixed-support analysis; parentpairedCI, allsignedpositive-negative/severe t/v uniononce/rescue/shortlong.
method.cost: Actual video decode/preprocess, prompt encoding, propagation, mask-to-box/writeback, transfers, model-load/startup and peak VRAM, PID/start. Same8 is not same compute. Never apply paper FPS or SAM2 speed ratio to this machine.

pilot.criteria: Correct input/weight/coverage/reset/mask-box contracts, finite outputs, actual time and VRAM/resource feasibility; no target accuracy-based checkpoint/rule selection.
pilot.full_release: Full1902/10303 only after root reviews fixed-pilot correctness and measured cost, records an explicit feasibility decision, and freezes a new independent execution plan. This preparation launches no model/GPU owner.

dependencies: Do not interrupt current CG or gamma queue; corruption remains paused. SAM2 unexecuted preparation is retained read-only but is no longer an active predecessor requirement. New generic-TTA plan must refer to EdgeTAM, not demand SAM2 results.
checkpoint: Official EdgeTAM full state loads strictly. Official timm constructor requests redundant pretrained RepViT initialization; a scoped no-download initialization adapter is permitted only with zero missing/unexpected final checkpoint keys and every loaded state tensor equal to the pinned official checkpoint. No vendor file editing.
extension: Identical official connected-components CUDA source and exact torch2.7/cu128 binary artifact may be reused; CPU import is not an actual CUDA-kernel or propagation test. Missing/failed postprocessing is a hard failure, no silent fallback.
